title: DeliveryManifest
description: Release truth record for a single design deliverable. Generated by CI per release. Documents token/component coverage, visual diff result, and release gate status.

releaseId.description: Unique identifier for this release (e.g., semver tag or CI run ID)

figmaFrameIds.description: Figma frame/node IDs covered by this delivery

totalTokensUsed.description: Count of distinct design tokens referenced in this deliverable

path.description: Token path that is missing or unresolved

acceptedBy.description: Name of approver if gap is accepted

libraryComponents.description: Count of design system library components used

customComponents.description: Count of one-off / bespoke components (should be 0 or documented)

storybookStoryIds.description: Storybook story IDs covering delivered component states

visualDiffResult.description: Result of visual regression baseline comparison

visualDiffReportPath.description: Path to the visual diff report (relative to repo root)

releaseThresholdMet.description: true only when all three production gates pass and no unaccepted gaps remain

notes.description: Free-form release notes or reviewer comments
